name: Rose hip oil
description: Rose hip oil (CAS 84603-93-0 ), also known as Rose Hips Seed Oil, is a cold-pressed vegetable oil extracted from the seeds of Rosa canina and related species. It is rich in unsaturated fatty acids and naturally occurring antioxidants. The oil is sourced primarily for its skin-conditioning and stabilizing properties across cosmetic, nutritional, and industrial formulations. In cosmetics, it functions as an active moisturizing ingredient in facial serums and anti-aging creams. Its high linoleic and linolenic acid content supports skin barrier formulations and body oils. Nutritional supplement manufacturers incorporate it into softgel capsules and functional food products targeting antioxidant support. Formulators in the pharmaceutical sector use it as a carrier oil in topical preparations where a lightweight, biocompatible base is required. It meets various industry requirements for purity and stability in these applications. In coatings and specialty adhesives, its drying oil characteristics make it suitable for oxidative cure systems and natural resin-based formulations. This versatility makes it a staple for diverse industrial manufacturing needs. Rose hip oil is supplied as a liquid oil, typically ranging from pale yellow to deep amber depending on extraction method and refinement level. Standard commercial grades include cosmetic-grade, food-grade, and technical-grade variants. Bulk supply is available in drums and IBCs, with cold-pressed, unrefined options commonly specified for premium cosmetic applications.
